lines.text: わたし は げんき

tasks.prompt: Write ざじずぜぞ ×3, saying each aloud (~4 min). Then read the 5 lines twice, slow then normal speed. Watch: さ vs ざ (two dots = voiced), し→じ, ね/ぬ/な, は/ほ.
tasks.script:
za ji zu ze zo
かぜ が つよい (kaze ga tsuyoi)
じかん が ない (jikan ga nai)
ごはん の あじ (gohan no aji)
ゆき の よる (yuki no yoru)
わたし は げんき (watashi wa genki)

questions.explain: ぜ = せ plus two dots.
が = か + dots; ぎ is gi.
ぬ nu curls at the end; め does not.

questions.q: In ごはん を たべる, how is を read?
